name: humid_air_steam_injection
title: Humid air with steam injection (Cengel 14-75)
summary: Teaching exercise (Cengel 14-75). Humid air at 10 °C and 70 % relative humidity is heated at constant humidity ratio, then humidified with saturated steam at 100 °C to 20 °C and 60 % relative humidity. The model finds the humidity ratio, the enthalpy and the state after the heater, per kg of dry air, plus the steam flow and the heater power.
